Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - S.C.C. No. 2252/2020

Dear Ms. Khan,

Thank you for meeting us on 27/08/2020 about your dispute with M/s Das Traders. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Nagpur.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹12,00,000.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa

spans.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Nagpur
